## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run audit`, `npm run lint` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] Tests cover the change (keyboard, events, form behaviour where it applies)
- [ ] A changeset is added (`npm run changeset`), or the change does not reach the package
- [ ] A visible change was checked in light and dark, right-to-left, and with the keyboard only
